design: 2 domains x 3 prompt arms x 2 independent Luna-high replicates; fork none; shared filesystem protocol isolation, not OS isolation
intervention: research search-framing prompt only; same task, sources, budget and reporting schema
primary_outcomes: survival and loss through Terra screening
secondary: verified peer-reviewed original sources vs other status
expert originals opened, factual followups and handoff defects
publication_check: original identity and venue/status plus direct content support; unverifiable/abstract-only separately labeled
quality_limits: no expert-seeded algorithm names or desired findings
no unsupported transfer of benchmark results or ideal bounds
no project execution or global configuration changes
analysis: Luna verifier per domain/replicate reads all three opaque-label reports, verifies critical source claims and publication status, merges duplicates and records disputed judgments. Terra screens with same template, retaining rejected consequential candidates. Sol reviews method before dispatch and compact decision packets/adoption later. Astra brainstorm already supplied strategic critique; not a routine per-paper gate.
usage: native requested model/effort and turns recorded; model tokens/provider identity/weekly attribution unavailable unless actual telemetry exposed; no inferred savings
heldout: common/heldout-task.md frozen before pilot results; fresh task and actual research pipeline, with baseline comparison limits explicit

resource_bounds.budget_note: Instructions and coordinator admission, not hard runtime metering. Nonresearch prep/review web documentation operations recorded separately.

dispatch_order: interleave arms across domains/replicates, recorded before dispatch; all12 may run concurrently under native capacity37
gate_corrections: analysis/protocol-review.md addressed with explicit scoring, provenance, stage matrix, total ceilings and transfer protocol; unchanged quality gates
